requirements.statement: The operation returns a ScriptsConformance record for one package directory: every file under its scripts/ directory with the facts THE RULE names (export count, a main guard, stdin read, stdout write, effect imports, source extension) and a conformant verdict per file plus totals.
Every verdict is derived from named facts in the file text (import specifiers and syntactic markers), and each fact is returned beside the verdict.

prohibitions.statement: The operation must refuse a request whose packageDir is not a non-empty string.
The operation must never import or execute the scripts it reads; it reads bytes only.

constraints.applicability: Applies to the shared examples projected to the JSNode import and command faces.
constraints.statement: Every admitted example has equivalent import and command outputs under the downstream JSNode face assay.

constraints.authority: THE RULE for scripts/ and src/ (owner-ruled 2026-09-04)
constraints.applicability: Applies to every file under a package scripts/ directory.
constraints.statement: A script is run, takes JSON in, puts JSON out, has at most one effect, and nothing in scripts/ works differently.

constraints.applicability: Applies to the .mjs operation, its import.meta.main guard, and downstream package-birth assays.
constraints.statement: The package uses one executable ESM operation source file that is eligible for downstream staged package-birth assays.

examples.name: a package without scripts has zero totals

acceptanceObligations.statement: The existing JSNode package-birth pipeline must admit, stage, test, pack, install, and assay the projected package.
